The '''Kingdom of Nogoyev''' was the Nogoyevian polity and constituent nation associated with the [[Union of Zhensanov]] before and during the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]]. The source uses "Kingdom of Nogoyev" for the wartime independence side, while later pages describe the restored state as the [[Tsardom of Nogoyev]].

This draft treats the kingdom as the historical and wartime Nogoyevian state identity, leaving the exact transition into the Tsardom open for later canon confirmation.

== Place In The Union ==

Nogoyev was incorporated into the Union of Zhensanov in the mid-19th century. The source describes this as a political incorporation initially supported by many Nogoyevians, but later undermined by centralization, economic grievance, and cultural resentment.

Nogoyev's capital, [[Migov]], remained the heart of Nogoyevian culture and politics. The region was located in the eastern part of the Union along the Vegar Ocean.

== Independence Movement ==

By the late 1940s, the [[All-Nationalist Nogoyev Party]] had become the main vehicle for sovereignty demands and Tsarist restoration. Its leaders argued that Nogoyev's monarchy represented national continuity and local self-rule against Zhensanovian centralization.

In 1949, Nogoyevian leaders declared sovereignty, beginning the Nogoyevian War of Independence.
